too_slow: The other machine is sending too slowly: transfer dropped, it will resume later.
not_here: Version not available on this machine.
still_waiting: The other machine still hasn't answered the previous request.
bad_reply: Unreadable reply from the other machine.
other_version: The machine sent a different version from the one announced.
interrupted: Transfer interrupted by the other machine.
bad_chunk: Chunk of unexpected size: transfer interrupted.
no_such_file: Version {version} does not deliver a “{kind}” file.
